title: ononis serrata subsp. diffusa
intro: Ononis serrata subsp. diffusa, commonly known as Spreading Restharrow, is a perennial legume plant native to Europe and Asia. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which may help to alleviate symptoms of various conditions such as arthritis, digestive issues, and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Ononis serrata subsp. diffusa are believed to be attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, improve circulation, and exert a mild diuretic effect. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
